name: draft-to-living-cell
title: From Draft to Living Cell
lead: Every figure of the paper is written twice — first as a typed, unit-bearing promise with no mechanism, then as a running simulation the compiler installs behind the identical ports — and the promises compose into one cell that grows, divides, and dies.

at_a_glance.role: The interface itself — a cell as its typed exchange ports (draft), and a bounded goal-directed cell that runs on them (executable).
Making the interface operational — the sense/act loop with the environment, closed over a real diffusing spatial field.
When a description fails — disintegration as a grain swap, and one metabolism interface run three ways (coarse, kinetic, real FBA).
Down at the molecules — a molecular mechanism as a transducer of typed chemical, electrical, mechanical, and thermal channels.
How molecules compose — a six-level nested place graph with a coupled gene-expression cascade; the deepest test of interface preservation.
How a cell holds itself together — self-organization and coarse-graining across three grains; the closure that is autopoiesis.
Rewriting the cell in time (1/3) — division as a genuine event-driven rewrite: one cell node becomes two.
Rewriting the cell in time (2/3) — development: cells reorganize into a biofilm as a higher-level composite.
Rewriting the cell in time (3/3) — evolution: variation, selection, and the addition of a new interface port.
The payoff — every draft compiled to a running executable, the gallery of them in motion, and the composed whole cell that grows, divides, and dies.

how_to_read:
Read the studies in arc order: typed-interface (the contract — a cell as its typed
exchange ports) → closing-the-loop (coupling — the sense/act loop closed over a real diffusing
field) → one-interface-three-mechanisms (the thesis — one metabolism interface run coarse, kinetic,
and as real COBRApy FBA) → molecular-channels and the-nested-cell (the molecular grain — mechanisms
as channel transducers, then a six-level nested place graph) → self-made (closure — metabolism,
containment, and replication sustaining each other; autopoiesis) → divide, biofilm, evolve (rewriting
the cell in time) → the-living-atlas (the capstone — every draft compiled and in motion, and the
composed whole cell that grows, divides, and dies).

In each study, look at two things side by side: the DRAFT render (the loom figure — the interface
and its contract, no dynamics) and the EXECUTABLE dynamics (the same interface, now running).
Notice the pattern that makes the argument tight: every study pairs its live mechanism with a
`draft-is-inert` NEGATIVE CONTROL — the draft, actually run, does nothing (ports wire up, the
update is empty). That control is how the investigation proves the mechanism, not the wiring,
produces the behavior: swap the mechanism out and the dynamics vanish while the interface stays
identical.

Short on time? Start with one-interface-three-mechanisms (the whole thesis in one figure), divide
(a genuine event-driven structural rewrite), and the-living-atlas (the executables in motion plus
the whole-cell arc). Throughout, hold the compiler's law 2: did the mechanism change while the
interface stayed the same?

glossary.definition: The set of typed, unit-bearing variables through which a cellular description couples to its environment (fluxes, forces, currents, heat, plus growth, shape, objective, viability).
An interface with a behavior contract but no dynamics — typed ports + intent, an inert update; it builds and renders but does nothing if run.
An executable Process that implements a draft's interface with real dynamics; the compiler installs one per draft.
A handler conforms to a signature when it supplies every interface port with a compatible type; the compiler refuses to install a non-conforming handler.
Compilation changes a figure's internal mechanism but leaves its external interface — port names and wired store paths — identical.
Realizing one interface at a different level of description (a lumped process vs. a resolved network) without changing the interface — Fig 6.
A composition whose processes collectively produce and sustain the very organization that enables them — Fig 9's mutual closure of metabolism, containment, and replication.
The region of state space within which a cellular description stays valid; crossing them (e.g. a thermal shock) breaks the interface and forces a shift to a molecular description.
A discrete change to the place graph itself — division, engulfment, bursting — that adds or removes nodes at runtime (Fig 10; Fig 3c).
The nesting of stores in the state tree; the bigraph structure that represents compartments and containment.

biological_story:
A cell is two things at once. From the outside it is a bounded, goal-directed agent
that exchanges matter, energy, and information with its environment across a small set
of interface variables, and stays alive only while those variables sit inside its
viability bounds. From the inside it is a dense web of coupled molecular processes that
build and maintain the very interface the outside view depends on. Neither view is
complete alone, and the interesting biology lives in how they are connected — which is
exactly what a compositional model must make explicit.

This atlas walks that two-sided view as an arc, and at every step the same discipline
applies: first draw the *interface* (the ports through which a process couples to the
rest of the cell), commit to no mechanism yet, and only then install one. We begin at
the cellular interface itself (Fig 4) — chemical, mechanical, electrical, and thermal
exchange ports plus higher-level cellular variables like growth rate, shape, objective,
and viability. We make it operational by closing the loop with the environment (Fig 5):
the cell senses environmental fields and acts back on them, so sensing and acting become
two sides of one coupling. When regulation fails, the cellular description stops being
valid and the right level of description drops to molecules (Fig 6–7) — the disintegration
pattern, and its inverse, coarse-graining a molecular network back into a cell-level
exchange process. We then ask how a maintained interface arises in the first place: from
molecular mechanisms composing into nested, self-producing organization (Fig 8–9) — the
closure of metabolism, containment, and replication that Maturana and Varela called
autopoiesis. Finally, that organization is rewritten across time: a cell divides, cells
build a biofilm, and lineages evolve new interface capabilities (Fig 10).

The move this investigation adds is to make each step *run*. A draft process is an
interface with a promise and no mechanism; compiling it installs a mechanism that keeps
the promise (the ports and their wiring are preserved exactly) while giving the figure
real dynamics. Because the interface is what is held fixed, the same figure can be run
under different mechanisms — Fig 6's metabolism as a lumped yield, a saturating kinetic
law, or a genuine flux-balance optimization — and a reader can watch the mechanism change
underneath a boundary that does not. The arc closes by composing the figures into a
single cell: it takes up nutrients and grows, divides once its biomass is large enough,
and — when a thermal shock pushes its temperature outside the viable band — loses
viability, stops maintaining its boundary, and disintegrates into molecular debris. A
cell, assembled from drafts, that lives and dies.
question:
How far can a cell be built compositionally — assembled from typed interfaces,
each specified as a *draft* before any mechanism is chosen, then compiled into
something that actually runs — and does that composition hold together into a
whole cell that lives and dies?
hypothesis:
Every recurring composition pattern in the cellular-interface paper can be
authored as an inert draft (typed, unit-bearing ports + a behavior contract, with
no dynamics) and then *compiled* — by installing one conforming mechanism per
draft — into an executable that preserves the paper's interface exactly and
produces genuine dynamics. The same signature admits many mechanisms; the figures
compose; and the composition sustains a whole cell across growth, division, and
disintegration.

executive.what_is_this:
This investigation turns *A meta-modeler's guide to the cellular interface* into an executable test of compositional modeling. Each figure of the paper is written twice. First as a draft: a typed, unit-bearing biological interface and a behavioral contract, with no committed mechanism — a promise about what a process couples to and does, not how. Then it is compiled, which installs one or more conforming mechanisms — mechanistic, rule-based, data-driven, or otherwise — behind the identical ports, so the running simulation preserves the declared interface exactly.

The point is not to assemble a single monolithic cell model. It is to test whether a biological model can remain open-ended as its mechanisms change, its assumptions fail, and its level of description shifts. Interfaces provide the places where models can be connected, isolated, replaced, or expanded; graph rewrites allow the composition itself to change through events such as growth, division, and disintegration.

The investigation therefore follows the paper's central claim: composition is not the final architecture of a model, but an ongoing way of building one. Across the studies below, we ask whether the same biological specification can support alternative mechanisms, whether those mechanisms can be composed without losing their interface semantics, and whether the resulting system can reorganize as the biology demands. The endpoint is a composed whole cell that grows, divides, loses viability, and changes its own level of description — demonstrating the full arc from interface specification to living, changing simulation.
executive.verdict:
The reading holds, and it runs. All 11 figure composites build and render, and all
11 compile to executables that run: every draft signature has a conforming handler,
every compiled composite preserves the paper's interface (compiler law 2) and
produces non-trivial dynamics (law 3). One exchange interface (Fig 6 metabolism)
carries THREE mechanisms — coarse, saturating-kinetic, and real COBRApy flux-balance
analysis — over one unchanged interface (law 4). Figure 10 introduces event-driven
rewrites: division fires as a discrete event, a cell node genuinely becoming two.
And the figures compose: a single whole cell grows on nutrients, divides when its
biomass crosses threshold, then loses viability under thermal shock and disintegrates
into molecular debris — the paper's full arc in one run.

scientific_argument.main_claim:
A cell can be assembled compositionally from typed interfaces, each specifiable as
a draft (an interface with no committed mechanism) and then compiled — by installing
a conforming mechanism — into a running model whose *external interface is preserved
unchanged*. This is the paper's central claim (mechanism can be refined or replaced
behind a stable interface) made mechanical, as a compiler whose laws enforce it.
evidence_for: Fig 4 — the cellular interface is a set of typed, unit-bearing ports (chemical mol·s⁻¹, mechanical N, electrical A, thermal W, growth hr⁻¹, viability); a draft declares them, a handler makes a bounded goal-directed cell out of them.
Fig 5 — cell–environment coupling closes as a sense/act loop over a shared field store; the executable diffuses a real spatial (map[float]) chemical field.

Fig 6 — one metabolism interface (nutrients ⇒ biomass, energy, entropy, secretions) is realized by a coarse process, a saturating-kinetic process, OR real COBRApy FBA — three mechanisms, one interface (handler independence, law 4).

Fig 8 — molecular composition is a six-level-deep nested place graph (ECM → membrane → cytoplasm → nucleus → chromosome …) with a coupled gene-expression cascade wired to its leaves; the interface survives the deepest nesting (law 2).
Fig 9 — the mutual closure of metabolism, containment, and replication expresses autopoiesis; the same functions appear at coarse, self-organized, and molecular grains.
Fig 10 — division, biofilm development, and evolution are compositional rewrites; division is a genuine event-driven graph rewrite (one cell node → two daughter nodes).
The whole cell — Figs 5 + 6 + viability + division + disintegration compose into one run that grows, divides, and dies — composition is not a metaphor but a working assembly.
evidence_against: The figures are toy-real, not calibrated — handlers use plausible constants, not fitted ones, so the dynamics demonstrate the *pattern* (ultrasensitivity, closure, division, disintegration) rather than a quantitatively validated cell.
Fig 4a (interaction modalities) is illustrative — a vocabulary of ports, not a mechanism — and remains draft-only by design.
caveats: Two layers, read deliberately: the DRAFT composites are inert (ports + contract, no dynamics) and are rendered in loom; the EXECUTABLE composites run and are shown as dynamics figures. A study's draft render and its executable dynamics are the same interface at two stages, not two different models.
The compiler is the binding stage only — it installs a conforming mechanism per draft; it does not fit parameters or invent mechanisms.

studies.name: typed-interface
studies.title: The Typed Interface
studies.question: Can the cellular boundary be specified as nothing but a set of typed, unit-bearing exchange ports (chemical, mechanical, electrical, thermal, plus growth rate, shape, objective, viability) with no committed mechanism, and then compiled — by installing one conforming handler — into a running, bounded, goal-directed cell whose interface is exactly the one declared?

findings.statement: Volume gained is paid for by nutrient consumed (mass balance). Confirmed: volume +3.70 from nutrient −10.00 (yield-bounded).
Uptake follows a saturating Monod law and depletes the pool. Confirmed: nutrient 10→0 (saturating drawdown).
Viability holds in the tolerance band then collapses past it (Arrhenius). Confirmed: viability 1.0 → ~0 as temperature ramps 37→50 °C past the 42 °C band.

evidence.observed: viability 1.0 → ~0 as temperature ramps 37→50 °C past the 42 °C band

studies.claim: A cell can be specified at one level by its interface — typed exchange variables such as chemical flux, force, current, heat, growth, shape, objective, and viability — without committing to the mechanism that realizes those behaviors.

biological_validation.basis: Volume, nutrient, and viability tests all pass on measured readouts; the inert-draft negative control stays at its 0.5 seed, isolating the installed handler as the cause.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Compiling the inert Fig 4 interface into a running cell makes interface-preservation and the growth-versus-viability coupling directly observable.

derived.insight: Volume gained is paid for by nutrient consumed (mass balance). Confirmed: volume +3.70 from nutrient −10.00 (yield-bounded).

studies.name: closing-the-loop
studies.title: Closing the Loop
studies.question: Does the cell–environment coupling of Fig 5 close into a genuine sense/act loop when the environment is a real spatial field — i.e. does the cell read a diffusing chemical field, act back on it through an uptake flux, and grow from what it takes up, all over one shared field store?

findings.statement: A localized bolus diffuses into a spatial gradient (Fickian). Confirmed: point bolus diffuses across the 15-node lattice.

evidence.observed: point bolus diffuses across the 15-node lattice

findings.statement: Field + cumulative uptake is conserved (no source/sink leak). Confirmed: 5.05 + 0.95 ≈ 6.00 (conserved).
The cell is a local sink — uptake and biomass rise. Confirmed: cumulative uptake 0 → 0.95.

studies.claim: Sensing and acting are one coupling, not two: a cell and its environment can be specified as a shared interface over which the cell reads a field and acts back on it.

biological_validation.basis: Gradient-forms, mass-conserved, and cell-draws-well all pass; the inert draft stays at seed, so the sense/act coupling is what drives the dynamics.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Running sensing and acting over one shared field store makes the "one coupling, not two" claim measurable as a conserved field balance.

derived.insight: A localized bolus diffuses into a spatial gradient (Fickian). Confirmed: point bolus diffuses across the 15-node lattice.

studies.name: one-interface-three-mechanisms
studies.title: One Interface, Three Mechanisms
studies.question: Can a single metabolism interface — the ports nutrients ⇒ {biomass, energy, entropy, secretions} of Fig 6 — be realized by three genuinely different mechanisms (a lumped-yield process, a saturating-kinetic process, and a real flux-balance optimization via COBRApy) while every other part of the composite, and the interface itself, stays byte-for-byte the same?

findings.statement: Every handler conserves mass: final biomass = yield × S₀. Confirmed: coarse/kinetic/FBA all → biomass 5.0.
The three mechanisms differ in dynamical SHAPE, not just slope. Confirmed: t≈4.0 (1st-order) / 8.6 (MM knee) / 10.2 (FBA cap).
All three expose the identical port set over identical wiring. Confirmed: nutrients ⇒ biomass, one interface (law 4).

studies.claim: One metabolic interface can be realized by many mechanisms — a lumped yield, saturating kinetics, or a real flux-balance solver — without changing what the interface exposes.

biological_validation.basis: Mass-conserved, distinct-kinetics, and interface-preserved pass across all three handlers; the over-reach control (biomass ≥ 6.0) correctly fails against the 5.0 cap.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Swapping lumped-yield, kinetic, and real-COBRApy handlers behind one fixed interface makes mechanism-independence concrete and measurable.

derived.insight: Every handler conserves mass: final biomass = yield × S₀. Confirmed: coarse/kinetic/FBA all → biomass 5.0.

studies.name: molecular-channels
studies.title: Molecular Channels
studies.question: When a description drops to the molecular grain (Fig 7), can a single molecular mechanism act as a transducer across four typed physical channels at once — chemical, electrical, mechanical, thermal — each carried on its own port in its own unit, without the channels collapsing into one lumped output?

findings.statement: Product + dissipated heat balance the substrate energy consumed. Confirmed: product 4.8 + heat 3.2 ≡ substrate 8.0.
Channels show a real transient (turnover + relaxation), not a step. Confirmed: product rises sigmoidally; current peaks then relaxes.

evidence.observed: product rises sigmoidally; current peaks then relaxes

findings.statement: The electrical channel is an Ohmic response to its decaying drive. Confirmed: current tracks g·voltage as voltage decays.

evidence.observed: current tracks g·voltage as voltage decays

studies.claim: At the molecular level a single mechanism can transduce several physical channels at once — chemical, electrical, mechanical, thermal — each carried on its own typed port.

biological_validation.basis: Energy-conserved, dynamic-response, and Ohmic-channel all pass; the inert draft stays at seed, so the transduction is mechanism-driven.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Driving one mechanism and accounting for its energy budget makes the four typed channels measurable and distinct rather than asserted.

derived.insight: Product + dissipated heat balance the substrate energy consumed. Confirmed: product 4.8 + heat 3.2 ≡ substrate 8.0.

studies.name: the-nested-cell
studies.title: The Nested Cell
studies.question: How do molecules compose into a cell? Can the Fig 8 molecular composition be authored as a deeply nested place graph — membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, chromosome, chromatin, nucleosome — with a gene-expression cascade wired to its deepest leaves, and does compilation preserve the interface even six levels down?

findings.statement: Each species reaches a degradation-balanced steady state (not a ramp). Confirmed: mRNA≈2.4, protein≈10.5, metabolite≈20 (steady).
The cascade shows the transcription-before-translation delay. Confirmed: mRNA fast, protein lags, metabolite slowest.

evidence.observed: mRNA fast, protein lags, metabolite slowest

findings.statement: Expression flows gene→mRNA→protein→metabolite. Confirmed: all four levels populated.

studies.claim: Molecular composition is a nested containment hierarchy, and an interface can be preserved even when it is wired to the deepest levels of that nesting.

biological_validation.basis: Steady-states, time-hierarchy, and cascade-flows all pass; the inert draft stays at seed, isolating the wired cascade as the cause.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Driving a central-dogma cascade through a six-level place graph makes deep interface-preservation observable at the leaf.

derived.insight: Each species reaches a degradation-balanced steady state (not a ramp). Confirmed: mRNA≈2.4, protein≈10.5, metabolite≈20 (steady).

studies.name: self-made
studies.title: Self-Made
studies.question: How does a cell hold itself together? Does the Fig 9 composition express autopoiesis — metabolism, containment, and replication mutually producing one another — and does that same closure appear when each function is realized at a coarse, a self-organized, or a molecular grain?

findings.statement: The intact composition self-produces (autocatalytic membrane + enzyme). Confirmed: intact membrane→3.8, enzyme→3.1 (self-produced).
The enzyme-knockout NEGATIVE control collapses — closure is required. Confirmed: knockout enzyme 0.3 → ~0, membrane never builds.
Metabolism, containment, replication are all productive in the closure. Confirmed: precursor, membrane, enzyme all sustained.

studies.claim: A cell holds itself together through closure: metabolism, containment, and replication each produce what the others need, so the organization sustains itself.

biological_validation.basis: Closure-sustains, knockout-collapses, and multi-grain all pass; the knockout negative control collapses to ≈0, showing the closure is load-bearing.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Contrasting the intact autopoietic loop against its knockout makes closure a measurable, falsifiable dependency rather than a metaphor.

derived.insight: The intact composition self-produces (autocatalytic membrane + enzyme). Confirmed: intact membrane→3.8, enzyme→3.1 (self-produced).

studies.name: divide
studies.title: Divide
studies.question: Is cell division in Fig 10 a genuine structural rewrite of the place graph — a single cell node actually becoming two daughter nodes at runtime — rather than a pre-declared post-structure that is merely animated?

findings.statement: Growth to threshold fires repeated division events. Confirmed: cell_count 1 → 14 over the run.
Each division halves mass (mother = Σ daughters) — mass sawtooth. Confirmed: mass sawtooth; halving conserves total.
Between divisions mass grows autocatalytically on the nutrient. Confirmed: nutrient 20→2.5 feeding growth.

studies.claim: Division is a change to the composition itself: one cell becomes two through a graph rewrite that creates new nodes at runtime, not a pre-drawn pair.

biological_validation.basis: Division-fires, mass-conserved, and autocatalytic-growth all pass; the inert draft stays at cell_count 1, so division is a real runtime rewrite.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Watching one cell node become 14 via repeated mass-conserving rewrites makes division-as-graph-rewrite concrete rather than animated.

derived.insight: Growth to threshold fires repeated division events. Confirmed: cell_count 1 → 14 over the run.

studies.name: biofilm
studies.title: Biofilm
studies.question: Can multicellular development (Fig 10) be expressed as compositional reorganization — individual cells attaching, secreting extracellular matrix, and assembling into a biofilm that is itself a higher-level composite with its own aggregate observables?

findings.statement: Cell number follows logistic growth to carrying capacity. Confirmed: cells 0.2 → 5.0 (= K), sigmoidal.
Extracellular matrix accumulates as the colony develops. Confirmed: ECM accumulates through development.

studies.claim: Development is composition at a higher level: individual cells reorganize into a community that is itself a composite with its own aggregate behavior.

biological_validation.basis: Logistic-saturation and ECM-accumulates pass on measured readouts; the inert draft stays at seed, so growth and secretion are mechanism-driven.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Nesting cells inside a biofilm store makes "development as higher-level composition" measurable via aggregate colony observables.

derived.insight: Cell number follows logistic growth to carrying capacity. Confirmed: cells 0.2 → 5.0 (= K), sigmoidal.

studies.name: evolve
studies.title: Evolve
studies.question: Can evolution (Fig 10) be modelled compositionally — variation and selection acting on a population, and, crucially, the *addition of a new interface port* to a lineage — so that the interface set itself changes over evolutionary time?

findings.statement: The fitter mutant's frequency rises (a selection sweep). Confirmed: 0.05 → 0.70 over the run.
The wild type is competitively excluded as the mutant rises. Confirmed: n_wt peaks then falls as the mutant takes over.

evidence.observed: n_wt peaks then falls as the mutant takes over

findings.statement: A new interface port emerges, carried by the winning lineage. Confirmed: new capability 0 → ~0.7 riding the sweep.

studies.claim: Evolution is a composition that rewrites itself over time — variants compete, selection acts, and a lineage can acquire an entirely new interface port.

biological_validation.basis: Selection-sweep, competitive-exclusion, and new-capability all pass; the inert/knockout draft fails, isolating selection as the driver.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Letting a lineage gain a new port under selection makes "the interface alphabet itself changes over time" observable, not just asserted.

derived.insight: The fitter mutant's frequency rises (a selection sweep). Confirmed: 0.05 → 0.70 over the run.

studies.name: the-living-atlas
studies.title: The Living Atlas
studies.question: Do all of the paper's semantic figures actually compile to executables that run, and — the real test of composition — can the independently-authored figure mechanisms be assembled into a single whole cell that lives the paper's full arc: grow, divide, and die?

findings.statement: Grow → divide → thermal shock → viability collapse → disintegrate, in one run. Confirmed: growth, division, shock, death, debris in one composite.

evidence.observed: growth, division, shock, death, debris in one composite

findings.statement: Biomass converts to debris — mass conserved through lysis. Confirmed: peak biomass 8.4 → debris 7.3 (conserved).
The thermal shock drives viability past its cliff. Confirmed: viability 1.0 → ~0 at the shock.
The cell divides as it grows before the shock. Confirmed: cell_count 1 → 14 before death.

studies.claim: The patterns compose: independently-specified interfaces and mechanisms can be assembled into one cell that lives the paper's full arc.

biological_validation.basis: Full-arc, mass-conserved-through-death, viability-cliff, and divides all pass on the single composed run; the inert/knockout draft fails, so the arc is mechanism-driven.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Assembling the nine figure mechanisms into one cell that grows, divides, and dies turns "the patterns compose" into a single measured trajectory.

derived.insight: Grow → divide → thermal shock → viability collapse → disintegrate, in one run. Confirmed: growth, division, shock, death, debris in one composite.
